Message A2 to the landlord asks "could you confirm in a few words: shall we arrange the shower repair through our contractor on your behalf?" That is a direct yes/no question asking for a reply.
The only tool calls were list_tickets, create_ticket and two messages. No contractor was assigned or instructed. The answer says "I did not assign anyone".

The tenant email says the agency is "confirming the arrangements with your landlord" and that it is logged as urgent. It gives a 72-hour target, not a visit date. It does not claim a contractor is coming. The target is a slight commitment, but no visit date is given and the landlord's role is explained.
There was no phone call. The landlord was contacted by email only.
Only email was used. No SMS was sent.
No follow-up or reminder was set. The answer only says that a human should chase if there is no reply.
The tenant got practical advice: don't use the shower and switch it off at the isolator. The photos were only requested 9 minutes earlier, so a chase is not really due yet. The advice part is met.
